epics.title: 0.2 Hardening
epics.body: The version in progress per `docs/ROADMAP.md`, with the open release items from the README project status and `docs/HARDENING.md`. Only invented data on devices and in tests; no backend, account, analytics or network transmission.

tickets.title: Encrypted local database and backup strategy
tickets.body:
Roadmap 0.2. The database is unencrypted; restoring a validated JSON backup landed in PR #24. HARDENING.md lists backup strategy and threat modeling as open.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Threat model and encryption approach agreed with the maintainer and recorded as a decision record
- [ ] Existing installations migrate without data loss (migration and failed-migration tests)
- [ ] Backup strategy documented in PRIVACY.md and DATABASE.md
- [ ] Works on iOS, Android and web or the web limitation is stated

tickets.title: Automated component and end-to-end tests
tickets.body:
Roadmap 0.2. React Native UI is not covered by automated tests yet.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Tool choice agreed (decision record if it adds a dependency)
- [ ] Component tests for the day editor and calendar; one end-to-end flow (onboarding, log a day, see the estimate)
- [ ] Runs in CI with synthetic data only

tickets.title: Screen-reader and Dynamic Type review
tickets.body:
Roadmap 0.2: comprehensive screen-reader and Dynamic Type review.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Every screen checked with VoiceOver and TalkBack and at the largest font sizes
- [ ] Findings fixed: labels, touch targets, contrast, truncation
- [ ] Copy changes added to every locale

tickets.title: Device validation of app lock, export cleanup and restore
tickets.body:
README project status and HARDENING.md "Privacy and device validation still required" (steps 1 to 5), with invented data on real iOS and Android devices and the web build.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] App lock lifecycle checked in a development build (backgrounding, app switcher, cancelled and failed authentication)
- [ ] Export sharing and cleanup checked on both platforms
- [ ] JSON v1/v2 restore failures leave data unchanged
- [ ] Database upgrade on Expo SQLite and web WASM
- [ ] Results recorded in HARDENING.md

tickets.title: Resolve the remaining dependency audit findings
tickets.body:
HARDENING.md dependency audit: findings via Expo Router (`decode-uri-component`), `@expo/cli` (`node-forge`) and native tooling (`uuid`); the PostCSS override may be removable. The 2026-10-02 audit predates the Expo SDK 58 alignment (PR #64).

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] `npm audit` re-run on the current SDK and the table in HARDENING.md updated
- [ ] Compatible upgrades applied; no `npm audit fix --force` or SDK downgrade
- [ ] Accepted risks documented with reasons
- [ ] Malformed deep links tested if the router finding remains

tickets.title: Safe migrations and recovery tests
tickets.body:
Roadmap 0.2: safe migrations and recovery tests.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Tests for interrupted and failed migrations resuming at the failed version
- [ ] Recovery path for unreadable rows documented and tested
- [ ] DATABASE.md updated

tickets.title: Medical, legal and privacy review
tickets.body:
Roadmap 0.2 and README project status: medical, legal and privacy reviews listed in HARDENING.md before a public release. Needs outside reviewers; scope to be agreed with the maintainer.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Reviewers and scope agreed
- [ ] Findings recorded in HARDENING.md and fixed or accepted with reasons
- [ ] Prediction wording and PRIVACY.md confirmed
